verdicts.reason: A has a clean left-to-right flow (watch, then a centred price/name/engraving stack, then Shop), but the Monograph logo is effectively gone: it has shrunk to a stray speck near the watch. The watch strap is also cropped at the top and bottom edges, and the price now outranks the product name. B keeps the logo but reduces it to an illegible thumbnail stuck on a stray 'Free engraving' line set low and left, apart from the centred text column, which leaves the bottom-left corner ragged and cluttered. B's watch is cropped the same way and its Shop button sits tight to the right edge, so A is the tidier and less broken of the two.
